decision.text: One global assistant pair per owner: Haiku fast cleaner (silent unless addressed by name) + Sonnet smart refiner/hand-off. Sessions.js voice pair is closest today; Chain.js (SERVEX_CHAIN=on) is the flagged fast tier + batch hand-off of Refine JSON to the standing mastermind. Layers.js per-page pair becomes a page context: every message tagged [on /path], (now on X) on a move = the one cross-navigation rule. Nothing renamed. Alternative: extend Sessions.js (out of fence). Smart tier and Steps/TaskLoop loop not built.
